title: User remains connected after account expiration, service restart, and deletion
body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.6.6

### Steps to reproduce

I am experiencing an issue where users are able to remain connected to services even after their accounts have expired, services have been restarted, and the users have been deleted from the databases. This behavior has been observed in the following scenarios:

Account Expiration: When a user's account expires, they should be disconnected from the network. However, in my case, users are able to continue using services even after their accounts have expired.
Service Restart: When services are restarted, any ongoing user sessions should be terminated. However, in my case, users are able to remain connected even after the services have been restarted.
User Deletion: When a user is deleted from the databases, they should no longer be able to access any services. However, in my case, users who have been deleted are still able to remain connected and access services.

### Logs

_No response_

### Expected behaviour

After account expiration, users should be disconnected.
After service restart, all ongoing user sessions should be terminated.
After user deletion, users should no longer be able to access any services.

### Observed Behaviour

Users remain connected and can use services after account expiration.
Users remain connected and can use services after service restart.
Users remain connected and can use services even after being deleted from the databases.
